summary: T3 Defense Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose the sale of 17,294,784 common shares to Esousa Group Holdings, LLC for $4,545,236 in aggregate gross proceeds, including a June 12, 2026 tranche of 15,187,265 shares at $0.25 per share (calculated). The sales were made under a September 19, 2025 common stock purchase agreement with registration on Form S-1 (No. 333-292209). The investor waived a prohibition on purchase notices under an equity line from February 24, 2026. This is an at-the-market equity drawdown, not a transformative special situation. No board recommendation, premium, or strategic review is involved. Watch for liquidity constraints if the equity line is exhausted.
